tools.name: trust_score
tools.description: Derived trust score (0-100) for an MCP server, computed from the lastseen.dev register's dated observations by a published method. The score carries DEPTH (how many of 5 dimensions were computable) BOUND INTO the number as `display`, e.g. '80 · depth 2/5 · provisional' — a depth-2 score answers a na

tools.name: schema_history
tools.description: Dated schema/tool-count observations for an MCP server (a series when known): first_seen, last_observed, drift events. Facts from the register, not a score.

tools.name: dependency_risk
tools.description: An MCP server's dependencies and their mortality state (dead/dormant counts) from the register. Facts, not a score.
